newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX, PHLX to list Anadigics options Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX, PHLX to list Anadigics options Feb 28.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE), American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Friday they would begin trading options on shares of Anadigics Inc on February 28.
The exchanges said the options would open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35 and initial expirations in March, April, July and October.
Anadigics shares ended down one at 30-1/2 Friday.
The AMEX and PHLX set position limits of 7,500 contracts.
At the CBOE, Genesis Trading Group LLC has been named the designated primary market maker for the options and at the AMEX, Charlton, Goin, SLK has been named specialist.
At the PHLX, TFM Investment Group has been named specialist.
